name: Monotonic Minimum Teaching-Set Size of Blockwise-Addressing
proof: The established identity $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^*=RTD$ applies to every finite class.  The directly verified Blockwise-Addressing value $RTD=2$ therefore gives $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^*=2$.
references: \cite{doliwa2014recursive,ben1997online}; derived using the established equality with RTD
